title: Mahishasura Mardini
provenance: Old Talab near Bhagavati shrine of villages virnora, pernem tq. Goa.
brief_description: Four handed heavy armed sculpture of Mahisasura - Mardhini in half relief.
detailed_description: Four handed heavy armed sculpture of Mahisasura - Mardhini in half relief. The godess is represented in her furious form the Mahisasuramardini, killing the demon Mahisha; her right foot is resting on the ground and left foot on the back of the Mahisha. She is holding ayuda in three hands and a lotus in the upper left hand; the upper right hand is striking a sword into the head of Mahisha and the lower left hand is piercing a dagger into the mouth of Mahisha. The goddess wears kiritha mukuta and prabhavali around her head.
